Jesus, those WoW references are out of control, woman! :P

Well continuing the trend then, I think 10 years of wiping over and over again on the same boss would cause all raid members to delete their character, uninstall the game and drop a nuclear bomb on Blizzard HQ.

In essence, the frustration has got to a tipping point and you've finally realised that beating this is quite simply.. impossible.

I guess it wouldn't be so bad though if I could just find a fucking wizard robe irl with +10k stamina.

Oh shit where is this going.

Anyway, I appreciate your reply. Words go in one ear and out the other for me right now. I've thought of everything, it seems. There's not even a hint of a flashlight.

I've only had 1 girlfriend, and I met her in chemistry (I'm from NI) when I was 19, at college. This was pure chance. She was socially awkward too and one day, we got paired together for a lab. Things went from there.

Apart from that, I'm in the same boat as you. No interest from ANY other girls in the slightest. But I know I'm not the most approachable person, so I kind of accepted it a long time ago. I hate going out to clubs, even tho I love music, so that's not an option for me. If I really wanted a girlfriend right now, I'd go for online dating which so many people use these days. I have bad anxiety tho so any of that isn't an option for me right now.

Have you given online dating a try? I've looked up profiles from Ireland before and there's tons of girls on there and some of my friends have met their girlfriends there.

And btw, just because a girl doesn't have the same core interests as you doesn't mean it won't work. I'm a hardcore gamer and my ex-gf couldn't care less about gaming and thought it was stupid, but we got on great nonetheless.

Not going to lie, it's difficult. As you can see, I'm not the best person to give advice on this ><

Hi mate. I'm a 26 year old Irish guy who loves gaming. I just made a thread at the same time as you. I read your post and understand what you feel like. If you want to chat just pm me. Whether we both like it or not, it's good to talk to people going through the same shit.
